sprint.name: Organizational Understanding Projection Shadow
sprint.classification: B — Projection Contract Valid, Compatibility Refinement Required
sprint.scope: Pure non-persistent disclosed Organizational Understanding projection with active Phase 8A product path unchanged.

evidence.claimBoundary: Thirty deterministic projection, disclosure, identity, availability, trace, replay, non-mutation, compatibility, and rollback checks.
Projection ownership, source map, disclosure enforcement, parity classification, limitations, activation blockers, and rollback.
Existing product behavior, deterministic Runtime replay, missing-data behavior, and non-mutation regression.
Existing resolved-decision disclosure, revocation, isolation, and truth noninterference contract.
Canonical DEPS evidence and reporting rules.

scorecard.rationale: Projection preserves and reshapes existing disclosed cognition without creating or revising organizational understanding.
The active product path is unchanged and no real-user or Local Understanding Utility outcome was measured.
No participation, cross-scope synthesis, contribution, or collective learning behavior changed.
The reusable shadow compiler requires an explicit disclosure result, fails closed, validates authority, and prevents supporting cognition from bypassing withheld compositions.
One reusable pure contract establishes deterministic projection, availability, and trace behavior for future experience adapters without adding persistence or duplicate truth.

architecture.observation: Projection responsibilities are isolated from cognition, authority, disclosure decisions, communication synthesis, UI, and Runtime persistence.
Composition, revision, Explanation membership, uncertainty, Evidence identity, and progressive trace references are preserved.
The current Phase 8A adapter remains the active source and no user-visible behavior changed.

benchmarks.summary: The existing Phase 5B disclosure and revocation contract remains passing and activation-blocked.
The active Runtime-backed product adapter and replay regression remain passing.
The projection shadow is pure, deterministic, fail-closed, traceable, non-persistent, and product-inactive.

researchObservations.observation: Local Understanding Utility and the six Organizational Understanding research dimensions were not evaluated because the treatment changes no active user experience or cognition.

introduced: One reusable projection contract and pure compiler.
complexity.justification: The additive shadow establishes one governed projection boundary that can replace duplicated direct Runtime probing after per-experience parity and disclosure activation.

governanceObservations.observation: Projection cannot infer eligibility and cannot reconstruct withheld or revoked Understanding through related support objects.

sustainabilityObservations.observation: The pure versioned contract centralizes normalization, availability, identity, and trace rules while leaving Runtime and the active adapter unchanged.

regressions.observation: The active Phase 8A source is not switched and existing organization experience behavior remains passing.

unknownsAndUnmeasured.reason: No production disclosure-decision producer exists and the active application does not invoke the shared compiler.
No user-visible treatment, Alpha comprehension protocol, or real-user outcome was evaluated.
The projection intentionally excludes prose synthesis and fixture-only Explanation title and summary fields.

remainingRisks.nextBlockingDependency: A canonical production disclosure-decision producer is required before application activation.
remainingRisks.remainingDiscoveryPhase: Phase 8 projection compatibility remains partial; broader Phase 5 Governance and Phase 6 remain paused.
remainingRisks.remainingBenchmarkGap: Active view-model, browser, user-comprehension, and revocation-in-application behavior remain unmeasured.

rollback.description: Remove the pure compiler, validator, and command; the untouched Phase 8A adapter remains active and Runtime requires no migration or rollback.

engineeringDecision.rationale: Accept the shadow contract while keeping application activation blocked pending compatibility refinement and a real resolved disclosure-decision producer.
